description: This file defines utility functions and patterns for matching and handling emoticons and emojis in text, including regex patterns for various emoticons, functions to match and replace emoticons, and rendering functions for emoji display.

methods.name: matchEmoticons
methods.description: Matches emoticons and emojis in the provided text after markdown formatting.

methods.name: handleEmoticons
methods.description: Replaces emoticons and emojis in the text with tokens or HTML spans, optionally rendering emojis.

methods.name: renderEmoji
methods.description: Returns an HTML span element representing the emoji with the given name.
